user.title: Wild Flame burner
user.description: The burner is only reachable on its own Wi-Fi (WILDFLAME…). Connect Home Assistant to that network first.

data_description.host: Address of the burner on its own Wi-Fi network. This is 192.168.4.1 unless you changed it.

reconfigure.title: Change the burner's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address of the burner. Home Assistant checks that it can reach the burner there.

data_description.host: Address of the burner on its own Wi-Fi network. This is 192.168.4.1 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the burner. Is Home Assistant connected to the burner's Wi-Fi?

abort.reconfigure_successful: The burner's address has been updated.

power_command_pending.message: The burner is still processing the previous on/off command. Try again in a moment.

child_lock_command_pending.message: The burner is still processing the previous child lock command. Try again in a moment.

child_lock_active.message: The child lock of the burner is on.

cooling_down.message: The burner is still cooling down (red light) and can only be switched on once that is done.

unknown_phase.message: The burner reports an unknown phase (code {phase}). Switching on is blocked for safety; check the burner.

not_burning.message: The flame level can only be changed while the burner is burning.
